State Of Tennessee Treasury Department increased its stake in Firstenergy Corp (FE) by 379.64% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Of Tennessee Treasury Department bought 436,905 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.28% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 551,988 shares of the central company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $18.77 million, up from 115,083 at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Of Tennessee Treasury Department who had been investing in Firstenergy Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.42B market cap company. (NYSE:FE) has risen 18.16% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 5.59% the S&P500.
